24P012 RTÉ Satellite News Gathering Vehicle Framework
Raidió Teilifís Éireann (“RTÉ”) intends to award a contract for the provision of a satellite news gathering vehicle. The successful tenderer will be appointed to a single party framework for future supplies of such vehicles.
